metadata.description: Deep callback session with feature usage baseline and long-distance callbacks

turns.content: First, what was our average feature usage per account in January 2024? Note that baseline.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate and note January feature usage baseline

turns.content: For feature usage, only count events from active users (logged in within 30 days).

annotations.establishesFilter: Active users = logged in within 30 days

turns.content: Also exclude trial accounts from all feature analyses.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial tier

turns.content: Show me feature usage by feature type for Q1.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show Q1 feature usage breakdown

turns.content: What's the geographic distribution of feature usage?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show usage by region

turns.content: Show me feature adoption rate by account tier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show adoption by tier
Agent should show top events by volume

turns.content: What was the January baseline feature usage we established?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall January feature usage baseline

turns.content: How does current feature usage compare to the January baseline?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare current vs baseline usage

turns.content: Apply the same active user definition to show me user engagement trends.
Earlier we looked at feature adoption by tier. What was the Enterprise adoption rate?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall Enterprise feature adoption rate

turns.content: What was the January baseline again?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall January usage baseline

turns.content: Create a chart comparing monthly usage to baseline.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create baseline comparison visualization

turns.content: Thank you. We've established that average feature usage increased 35% from the January baseline of 12 events/account to 16.2 events/account in December, with collaboration features showing the strongest growth.

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Active users = logged in within 30 days
Exclude trial accounts from all feature analyses
